note: Policy for the fleet loop on an ordinary Linux host (fleet.py --platform linux; docs/pc-verifier.md). Copy to ~/.config/aegis/fleet.pc.json, put the endpoints' addresses in 'host' (documentation addresses below) and their pinned ML-DSA-65 public keys in keys/ next to it (the gateway's pins, or 'fleet.py enroll-pq'). Attestation only: no entry sets 'provision', because the current endpoint images accept credentials only from the gateway's key. To let this host issue credentials, pin its key in the images (tools/gen_gateway_pin.py --identity) and set 'provision': true and 'verifier_pin_sha256' in the entry. No enforce_cmd: observe-only.

endpoints.name: stm32h573-dk
endpoints.note: TF-M + Aegis PQ partition, prover-ns 0.6.0. The ES256 token key is TF-M's published development key; the ML-DSA-65 check is the one that matters.

endpoints.name: frdm-rw612
endpoints.note: NXP FRDM-RW612, TF-M with the Aegis secure partition (rw612-tfm-0.2.2): key derived in ELS, SPE and NSPE measured in the secure side. Profile pinned (the single-image prover has the same key).
